name: Leak detection and repair
summary: We find where water is getting in, fix it and reseal the weak spots before it causes rot or mould.
includes: Finding where the water is getting in
Resealing the roof, windows and other weak spots
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
Where you’ve seen stains, soft spots or water, and after what kind of weather

faq.q: There’s a water stain on the ceiling. Is it urgent?
faq.a: Book it in soon. Water that gets into the roof or walls can cause rot and mould long before you see much on the inside.

faq.q: How often does the roof need resealing?
faq.a: It depends on the roof and how the RV is stored. We check the sealant during preventative maintenance and tell you when it needs doing.

faq.q: How much does leak repair cost?
faq.a: We can’t say until we’ve found the leak, so we quote after we’ve inspected it.
